comparisons.reason: Different row functions. Left returns 1 only if every comment is a refutation (reasoning or evidence) and none explicitly validates the OP's dignity or effort. It returns null for an empty list. Right returns 1 if at least one comment is a logical refutation and no comment has specific empirical evidence. It returns 0 for an empty list. Left allows evidence-based refutations and excludes OP-validation. Right excludes empirical evidence and ignores validation. Quantifiers (all vs. at least one), exclusion criteria and empty-list handling all differ.
